findings.title: Freshness composition must not be relabeled as a fresh cross-stack or browser run
findings.rationale:
Why now: cp36i has fresh API evidence only. The source freeze shows exactly one changed file, api-app/src/integrations/meta/meta.client.spec.ts, while the other eight named public paths match cp36h. The historical browser manifests intentionally retain the old unit-spec hash. tsconfig.build.json excludes **/*.spec.ts, so unchanged Web/browser consumer evidence is reusable, but it cannot become a fresh browser or all-suite claim merely by arithmetic.

Options:
A. Report a fresh all-suite/browser result from combined counts. Effort: low; risk: high evidence overstatement; structural/elegance impact: poor.
B. Keep the current wording: fresh API 173-unit plus 288-PG leaf, with historical h Web-28/browser-47 reuse for byte-identical consumer sources. Effort: low; risk: controlled; recommendation: this option.
C. Run a new full browser/cross-stack suite after a future candidate checkpoint. Effort: higher; it provides stronger fresh platform evidence but is unnecessary to validate the spec-only compiled-output-neutral delta itself.

Recommendation: B unless a later gate needs a newly served browser/runtime assertion.
